package.description: Combine decades of scattered email into one private, de-duplicated archive on your own computer.

en-US.description: Combine decades of scattered email into one private, de-duplicated archive on your own computer.
en-US.longDescription: EmailAttic is a local-only desktop app that turns decades of scattered email into one clean, organized archive. Point it at old accounts, Google Takeout downloads, and PST, OST and MBOX backup files; it reads them all, removes the duplicates, and files everything by mailbox into ordinary folders you can open for decades. Nothing is ever uploaded, no account, no cloud, no subscription. One-time purchase with a free trial.
en-US.name: EmailAttic
